name: Mayur Restaurant
why_it_matters: Manali's oldest surviving Indian restaurant, just off Mall Road on Old Mission Road in Aleo. The tandoori trout has been the house signature for five decades, and the kitchen still runs a wood-burning tandoor through winter — one of the few in town that does.
insider_tip: Order the sepu badi — a Himachali lentil-dumpling dish in palak gravy that almost no Mall Road kitchen still cooks. Tandoori trout is the headline; sepu badi is the quiet local order.

name: Sher-e-Punjab
signature_dish: sarson da saag with makki di roti
must_try: sarson da saag with makki di roti
why_it_matters: A 1972-vintage Punjabi kitchen that pre-dates most of new Manali. The Aleo branch sits below the Mall Road original and tends to be the calmer, family-friendly room — same tandoor, less footfall.
insider_tip: Winter visit? Order the sarson da saag with makki di roti and a glass of lassi — they pull butter from a local dairy and the saag is a slow-cooked all-day batch, not the buffet shortcut version.

name: il Forno
why_it_matters: Set inside Kedar Cottage — an 1860 Kathkuni-style timber-and-stone house that survived the 1905 Kangra earthquake. The wood-fired pizza oven is the draw; the apple-orchard setting and Himalayan views are why people stay for three hours.
insider_tip: Most greens come from il Forno's own kitchen garden, so vegetable specials change with the season. Skip the regular margherita and ask for the Fiametta — it's the kitchen's house pie.

name: Cafe Amigos
why_it_matters: Listed on Zomato as both Cafe Amigos and Amigos German Bakery — the same Aleo Mall outfit, half cafe, half bakery counter. Reliable filter coffee, fresh-baked cheesecake, and live guitar most evenings.
insider_tip: The cheesecake is what locals come for — bake by mid-morning, sells out by sundown. Get there before 6pm if you want a slice; after that the kitchen leans pizza-and-burger.

name: Indian Flavours
why_it_matters: Family-run restaurant on the Manali outskirts near the Volvo bus stand, perched above the Beas with a riverfront deck. The owners cite ~24 years in the food trade; the menu spans Punjabi, South Indian, Chinese and Continental — built for mixed-state family groups arriving off long-distance buses.
insider_tip: If you've just stepped off an overnight Volvo, this is the closest sit-down dining room with real cooking — call ahead, order the Punjabi thali, and ask for a riverside table on the lower deck.
signature_address: Near Volvo Stand, NH-3, Aleo, Manali 175131

name: Cafe 1947
why_it_matters: Riverside on the Beas at Bahang on the Solang/Leh-Manali highway. Currently #9 of 221 Manali restaurants on TripAdvisor — the draw is the willow-shaded outdoor seating with the river running past, plus live musicians most evenings.
insider_tip: Live music starts around 7pm and the riverside tables fill fast — book ahead for a Friday-or-Saturday evening table. Daytime is quieter and lets you actually hear the river.
signature_address: Near Nehru Kund, Solang Highway, VPO Bahang, Manali 175103

name: The Bunk Street Kitchen & Cafe
why_it_matters: 24-hour pure-veg kitchen attached to The Bunk Street hostel/hotel near Nehru Kund — useful catch-all for late-arrival groups, Jain travellers, and anyone driving in from Rohtang at odd hours when most of Manali is shut.
insider_tip: Jain food on demand and a fireplace through winter make this the practical winter pure-veg pick when Mall Road shuts at 10pm. Call ahead at peak season — the kitchen is small.
signature_address: Leh Manali Highway, Near Nehru Kund, Bahang, Manali 175103

name: The Avalon Cafe
why_it_matters: Opposite Nehru Kund Bridge in Bahang — currently #44 of 221 Manali restaurants on TripAdvisor with a 4.7 user rating across 100+ reviews. Theme-styled artwork, snow-mountain views, and shisha service make it a younger-crowd favourite away from Mall Road noise.
insider_tip: Pick the riverside-facing terrace, not the indoor section. Shisha service is a draw but kitchen does Italian and Chinese well — order pasta or pizza, not the fusion dishes.
signature_address: Nehru Kund Heights, Opposite Nehru Kund Bridge, Bahang, Manali 175103
